author: National Geographic
description:
Paid content for @gileadsciences. In Kisumu, Kenya, National Geographic Explorer and photographer Rena Effendi meets with Brenda Odera, a volunteer HIV prevention advocate working to expand awareness of PrEP, a medication that can help reduce the risk of HIV before exposure. After her own experience with PrEP, Brenda began volunteering in her community to connect vulnerable young women with information, resources, and local clinics. Through conversations with Brenda, Dr. Jared Olwal, a clinician at a PrEP clinic, Professor Elizabeth Bukusi, Chief Research Officer at the Kenya Medical Research Institute, and Florence Riako Anam, Co-Executive Director of the Global Network of People Living with HIV, the story explores the importance of education, access, and confronting stigma around HIV prevention. Gilead Sciences is working with local partners to help advance efforts not only to treat HIV, but to prevent it and create a future that is HIV free.

description:
From “The Lion King” director Jon Favreau and BBC Studios executive producer Mike Gunton comes the extraordinary true story of a lion cub named Kio on his epic journey to become a king. Filmed over four years, this sweeping saga of family, hope and courage follows Kio as he grows from a vulnerable cub into a powerful leader. Along the way, he faces loss, exile and fierce rivals in a fight to survive. Combining cinematic storytelling with groundbreaking natural history filmmaking, this series captures the complete coming-of-age story of a lion — and the remarkable making of a king.

description:
In this full episode of Inside the CIA: Secrets and Spies from National Geographic, meet Darrell Blocker, a former American intelligence officer, and learn about a father’s mission to bring justice to one of the most feared members of the Taliban. The mission reaches a turning point when a teenage boy within his inner circle is captured during a raid. This newfound access, combined with the CIA’s most secretive tracking technology, brings the agency inches from the man they call “The Butcher.”
